```artifact
Feature: User Login and System Administration

  Scenario: User Login
    Given a valid login id/username and password
    When the user attempts to log in
    Then the user should be granted access to the system

  Scenario: Administrator Sets Up Users/Passwords
    Given the Administrator is logged in
    When the Administrator sets up a new user with a valid username and password
    Then the user should be able to log in with the new credentials

  Scenario: Administrator Sets Up Control File
    Given the Administrator is logged in
    When the Administrator sets up a control file with a valid pincode
    Then the pincode should be stored securely

  Scenario: Administrator Creates Appointment File
    Given the Administrator is logged in
    When the Administrator creates a new appointment file
    Then the appointment file should be stored and accessible

  Scenario: Administrator Views/Prints Invoice
    Given the Administrator is logged in
    When the Administrator views or prints an invoice
    Then the invoice should be displayed or printed correctly

  Scenario: Administrator Backs Up Data
    Given the Administrator is logged in
    When the Administrator initiates a backup
    Then the data should be backed up successfully

  Scenario: Administrator Archives Patient Profiles
    Given the Administrator is logged in
    When the Administrator archives a patient profile
    Then the patient profile should be archived and inaccessible

  Scenario: Administrator Creates Doctor(s)
    Given the Administrator is logged in
    When the Administrator creates a new doctor
    Then the doctor should be added to the system

  Scenario: Administrator Creates Chemists and Labs
    Given the Administrator is logged in
    When the Administrator creates a new chemist or lab
    Then the chemist or lab should be added to the system

  Scenario: Administrator Maintains Speciality
    Given the Administrator is logged in
    When the Administrator maintains a speciality
    Then the speciality should be added, updated, or deleted as specified

  Scenario: Administrator Adds Speciality
    Given the Administrator is logged in
    When the Administrator adds a new speciality with a valid speciality id, name, and description
    Then the speciality should be added to the system

  Scenario Outline: Administrator Edits/Updates Speciality
    Given the Administrator is logged in
    When the Administrator edits or updates a speciality with a valid speciality id, name, and description
    Then the speciality should be updated in the system

    Examples:
      | speciality_id | speciality_name | speciality_description |
      |---------------|-----------------|------------------------|
      | 1             | Cardiology      | Heart and blood vessels|
      | 2             | Dermatology     | Skin and diseases      |
      | 3             | Neurology       | Brain and nervous system|
```
